newsitem.title: USA: Walgreen March same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Walgreen March same-store sales up.

text.p: Walgreen Co said Wednesday its March same-store sales rose 12.6 percent.

Total sales increased 18.2 percent to $1.18 billion from $996.2 million for the same month in 1996. Pharmacy sales, which account for 45 percent of overall sales, rose 18.2 percent, while comparable pharmacy sales rose 13.3 percent.
Sales this year benefited from an early Easter, which came in April last year and March this year, the company said.
Calendar year-to-date sales were $3.35 billion, up 14.9 percent from $2.91 billion for 1996.
Fiscal year-to-date sales for the seven months were $7.83 billion, up 14.1 percent from $6.87 billion.
At March 31, Walgreens operated 2,268 drugstores in 34 states and Puerto Rico compared with 2,138 a year ago.
